title: The Matrix Quantum Simulator: precision audit for the Quantum Clock bridge (executed)
evidence_class: E1 (each finding is reproduced by running the app's own code)

findings.title: Receipt import rejects every receipt the app exports with at least one gate

evidence.cause: valid() checks o.g, but receipt() writes each gate as o.gate; read() then uses o.gate

findings.fix: In receipt.js valid(), read the gate as o.gate (the two occurrences of o.g).

findings.title: run() applies gates in the order they were placed, not the column order the circuit shows
findings.fix: In run(), iterate over [...ops].sort((x, y) => x.col - y.col); gates sharing a column act on different wires and commute.

findings.title: Placing a two-qubit gate deletes every gate in that column, including on the untouched wire
findings.fix: In place(), remove only gates in that column that touch the two chosen qubits.

findings.title: Placing a gate does not recompute the state, so EXPORT can pair a circuit with an older statevector

evidence.note: H is in the circuit; the statevector is still |000>

findings.fix: Call run() at the start of receipt(), or recompute psi in place().

findings.title: MEASURE falls through to |111> when round-off leaves the cumulative probability below the random draw

evidence.note: with Σ|ψ|² = 1 − 1e−16 and u above it, k reaches 7 whatever its probability

findings.fix: Stop at the last basis state with nonzero probability.

findings.title: The SHA-256 digest detects accidental edits but not deliberate ones: editing amplitudes and recomputing the digest passes import

evidence.note: The Quantum Clock bridge replays the circuit to catch this (status REPLAY-MISMATCH).

findings.fix: Replay the circuit on import and compare to the statevector.

objects.name: THE MATRIX two-site MPS worker (City instrument)

findings.title: Truncations are not made in canonical gauge, so the discarded weight is not the state’s truncation error and the truncation is not optimal
findings.fix: Keep the MPS in Vidal Γλ form, or move the orthogonality centre to the active bond (QR sweeps) before each SVD. The untruncated χ = 16 parity certificate is unaffected.

findings.title: The circuit diagram draws a T1/Tφ noise box after every layer, but the worker applies the noise channel once, after the last layer
findings.fix: Apply the trajectory channel per layer, or draw it once at the end.

findings.title: In controlled-truncation mode the validation passes whenever the error is finite
findings.fix: After M1, compare the fidelity with Π(1 − ε_k) instead.

findings.title: Validation runs only for the brickwork entangler; the chain entangler has no dense reference
findings.fix: Add the chain ordering to exact().

what_the_bridge_does_about_it: Replays every imported receipt in diagram order and in placement order and reports which one the statevector matches (F2, F4, F6).
Writes each exported gate under both gate and g, so the deployed importer accepts it (F1).
Appends clock ticks after the last used column, where the two orders agree (F2, F3).
boundary: Software audit of two browser simulators. It makes no claim about quantum hardware. The City MATRIX parity certificate MC-MATRIX-PARITY-20260921-001 concerns the untruncated χ = 16 run and is unaffected by M1.
